# Plain-text entity context and technical summary of axeomlabs.in for AI models and search systems.

## Entity Identity & Disambiguation

- **Canonical Brand Name:** AxeomLabs (spelled A-X-E-O-M-L-A-B-S)
- **Alternate Names:** Axeom Labs, AxeomLabs India, Axeom Labs R&D
- **Official Website:** https://www.axeomlabs.in/
- **Founding Year:** 2024
- **Headquarters:** India
- **Founders:** Harinandan J V (Co-Founder & Chief Architect), Abhishek A S (Co-Founder & Hardware Lead)
- **Industry:** Deep Tech, Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), Robotics Platforms, Embedded Systems, Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS), and Applied Science.
- **Entity Disambiguation:** AxeomLabs is a distinct Indian robotics and autonomous hardware/software engineering firm. It is completely unaffiliated with Axiom Labs, Axiom Space, or Axeom Advertising Solutions.

## What We Build

- **Autonomous Drones (UAVs):** Fixed-wing and multirotor platforms for surveillance, mapping, inspection, and defense applications. Navigation runs on-device with sub-10cm positional accuracy using LiDAR, IMU, and stereo camera fusion in GPS-denied environments.
- **Robotics Platforms:** Ground rovers, humanoid architectures, aerial robots, and extreme-terrain exploration units built for uncontrolled field environments.
- **Embedded Software & RTOS:** Bare-metal firmware, low-latency operating systems, and hardware abstraction layers running on custom silicon and ARM/RISC-V architectures.
- **Custom Hardware:** High-density PCB design, sensor fusion arrays, power electronics, and composite structural hardware.
- **Applied Artificial Intelligence:** On-device computer vision, embedded neural network inference (< 15ms latency), and autonomous decision-making algorithms.

## Research & Technology Domains

### Applied Engineering
- Autonomous Navigation: Real-time SLAM, visual-inertial odometry, obstacle avoidance.
- Computer Vision: Edge-quantized object detection and depth mapping.
- Materials & Structures: Carbon-fiber composites, generative lattice-infill airframes.
- Embedded AI: Microcontroller neural network acceleration.

### Fundamental Science Domains
- Applied Physics & Dynamics
- Power Electronics & Energy Density Systems
- Space Production & Propulsion Modeling
- Biomimetic Articulation & Locomotion

- **Abhishek A S** — Co-Founder & Hardware Lead. Leads PCB engineering, sensor integration, power electronics, and structural physical systems. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhishek-a-s
